docs: Wrap a graphic in polar coordinates into a circle at the center, keeping the resolution. The horizontal axis is a full turn from the start angle, going clockwise. The vertical axis is the radius, the top is the center and the bottom is half the height out. Outside of the circle is transparent.

inLets.info: The angle the leading edge of the source is placed at. Zero points right and the turn goes clockwise.
